description: This Rust source file implements a server for the VISS (Vehicle Information Service Specification) version 2, providing asynchronous get, set, subscribe, and unsubscribe functionalities for vehicle data. It manages data access, permissions, and streaming of subscription events, including metadata generation and stream handling.

classes.name: SubscriptionHandle
classes.description: Manages subscription abort handles, automatically aborts stream on drop.

classes.name: Server
classes.description: Implements the Viss trait, managing data broker interactions, permissions, and subscriptions.

methods.name: new
methods.description: Creates a new Server instance with data broker and authorization.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Handles data retrieval requests, including metadata and datapoints.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Handles setting actuator values with permission and type checks.

methods.name: subscribe
methods.description: Handles subscription requests, manages stream creation and abort handles.

methods.name: unsubscribe
methods.description: Removes a subscription and aborts its stream.
